decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line that gained its own page by 2024, it reflects rising public commitment and investment, which makes management likely to persist with it.
This comfort insole remains less visibly backed than the main footwear lines, but as a close complement to the firm's work-shoe business it is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
The supportive insole has only modest website prominence and sits in a crowded adjacent niche, yet escalation of commitment and its fit with the work-shoe portfolio still favor continuation.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page in both years, signaling strong ongoing commitment to a strategically central product family that management will be reluctant to abandon.

Firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to a dedicated page, indicating increasing investment and a public push into a specialized professional-footwear segment that management is likely to defend.
The moulded insole stayed on the home page and is backed by a concrete customer-use result, so both visible commitment and positive evidence strongly favor keeping it on the market.
